facts.text: Jon expresses gratitude for Gina's encouragement and mentions that dance has the power to bring people together and create meaningful moments.

evidence.quote: Dance has the power to bring us together and create sweet moments. Moments like this remind me why I'm chasing my dream and keep me pushing through any struggles.
Feeling supported by all of you means so much. It gives me the oomph to keep chasing my dreams.

facts.text: Gina assures Jon that he has a solid community supporting him and encourages him to keep pushing forward.

evidence.quote: Take comfort in knowing you've got a solid community cheering you on, me included. Keep on pushing!
Feeling supported by all of you means so much. It gives me the oomph to keep chasing my dreams.

facts.text: Jon acknowledges Gina's faith in him as a significant source of motivation and states he will not let her down.

evidence.quote: Your faith in me is priceless - I won't let you down!
Thanks, Gina! Your faith in me is a real boost. I'm gonna make my dreams come true!

facts.text: Jon mentions that he is excited to guide and mentor aspiring dancers on their dreams.

evidence.quote: I'm also excited to guide and mentor aspiring dancers on their dreams.
Thanks, Gina! Your faith in me is a real boost. I'm gonna make my dreams come true!
